dct_title_s: Martin Ulvestads kart over Nordvesten og hovedströget af "Norge i Amerika": Minnesota, Wisconsin, Nord og Syd Dakota med de tilstödende Dele af Nebraska, Iowa, Illinois og Michigan
dct_alternative_sm: Martin Ulvestads kart over Nordvesten og hovedströget af "Norge i Amerika": Minnesota, Wisconsin, Nord og Syd Dakota med de tilstödende Dele af Nebraska, Iowa, Illinois og Michigan
dct_description_sm: Map of Minnesota, Wisconsin, North Dakota, and South Dakota showing state lines, counties, roads, and rivers. Shows cities and towns with Norwegian populations. Cities and towns with Norwegian churches are shown as orange dots.; "Published as part of 'Norge i Amerika med kart', a brief work that sought to document all major Norwegian settlements in America." - from dealer's description; Includes text.
46 x 68 centimeters, on sheet 48 x 77 centimeters, folded in cover 24 x 16 centimeters
